---
title: "Temperature Animation"
description: "Click a map to watch decades of daily high and low temperatures draw themselves, year over year."
author: "Eric Schnitger"
date: 2026-11-10
categories: [JavaScript, Climate]
image: thumbnail.png
page-layout: full
---

Click the map (or search for a place) to animate its daily high and low temperatures. In the upper chart, each year draws from January to December, then fades over the following ten years; the two horizontal lines are the average daily high and low over the previous 365 days. The lower charts plot those two averages, and the gap between them, across the whole period as the animation runs, so long-term trends show up. Each lower line is smoothed with a one-week average. The dashed line in each is a straight-line trend fitted to the data drawn so far, with its slope shown in degrees per decade.

```{=html}
<style>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // ---- Settings you may want to change --------------------------------
  var DEFAULT_PLACE = { lat: 34.1478, lon: -118.1445, name: 'Pasadena, California' };
  var FADE_YEARS = 10;          // a finished year takes this long to disappear
  // Site palette (theme.scss / site_style.py): brick, indigo, and the neutral third series.
  var HIGH_COLOR = '#a63d2f';
  var LOW_COLOR  = '#33548c';
  var DIFF_COLOR = '#7a7466';
  var SPEEDS = [8, 5, 3, 2, 1, 0.5, 0.25, 0.1];   // seconds per year, slowest to fastest
  var TREND_MIN_DAYS = 730;     // lower charts: days of data needed before a trend line is drawn
  var TREND_SMOOTH_DAYS = 7;    // lower charts: average the lines over this many days
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var root = $('ta-root'), canvas = $('ta-canvas'), ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var trend = $('ta-trend'), tctx = trend.getContext('2d');
  var statusEl = $('ta-status'), playBtn = $('ta-play'), scrub = $('ta-scrub');
  var yearEl = $('ta-year'), speedEl = $('ta-speed'), speedLabel = $('ta-speedlabel');
  var startEl = $('ta-start'), unitBtn = $('ta-unit');

  var S = null;            // the loaded dataset
  var pos = 0;             // current position in days (fractional)
  var playing = false, lastT = 0;
  var unit = 'F';
  var place = null, reqId = 0, cache = {};
  var marker = null, map = null, inflight = null;
  var RETRY_WAITS = [3, 8, 15];   // seconds to wait before each retry when the service is busy
  var thisYear = new Date().getFullYear();
  startEl.max = thisYear - 1;

  // Status line plus a large overlay on the charts while data is loading (or failed to load).
  function setStatus(msg, mode, detail) {
    statusEl.textContent = msg;
    var ov = $('ta-overlay'), tx = $('ta-overlaytext');
    if (mode === 'loading' || mode === 'error') {
      tx.textContent = msg;
      if (detail) { var sm = document.createElement('small'); sm.textContent = detail; tx.appendChild(sm); }
      ov.className = 'ta-overlay' + (mode === 'error' ? ' ta-error' : '');
      ov.hidden = false;
    } else ov.hidden = true;
  }

  // ---- Data ------------------------------------------------------------
  function isoDaysAgo(n) {
    var d = new Date(Date.now() - n * 864e5);
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  function build(daily, startYear) {
    var time = daily.time, hi = daily.temperature_2m_max, lo = daily.temperature_2m_min;
    var n = time.length;
    while (n > 0 && (hi[n - 1] == null || lo[n - 1] == null)) n--;   // drop the unfilled tail
    if (n < 30) throw new Error('No temperature data for this spot.');

    var x = new Float32Array(n), year = new Int16Array(n);
    var yStart = {}, yEnd = {}, min = Infinity, max = -Infinity;
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var y = +time[i].slice(0, 4), m = +time[i].slice(5, 7), d = +time[i].slice(8, 10);
      var doy = Math.round((Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d) - Date.UTC(y, 0, 1)) / 864e5);
      var len = (y % 4 === 0 && (y % 100 !== 0 || y % 400 === 0)) ? 366 : 365;
      x[i] = (doy + 0.5) / len;
      year[i] = y;
      if (!(y in yStart)) yStart[y] = i;
      yEnd[y] = i;
      if (hi[i] != null && hi[i] > max) max = hi[i];
      if (lo[i] != null && lo[i] < min) min = lo[i];
    }

    // Trailing 365-day averages (a "yearly average" that moves smoothly).
    function trailing(a) {
      var out = new Float32Array(n), sum = 0, cnt = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (a[i] != null) { sum += a[i]; cnt++; }
        if (i >= 365 && a[i - 365] != null) { sum -= a[i - 365]; cnt--; }
        out[i] = (i >= 364 && cnt >= 300) ? sum / cnt : NaN;   // only once a full year is available
      }
      return out;
    }

    // The request includes one earlier warm-up year so the averages are complete from day one.
    var i0 = (startYear in yStart) ? yStart[startYear] : 0;
    function range(a) {
      var mn = Infinity, mx = -Infinity;
      for (var i = i0; i < n; i++) if (!isNaN(a[i])) { if (a[i] < mn) mn = a[i]; if (a[i] > mx) mx = a[i]; }
      return { mid: (mn + mx) / 2, span: mx - mn };
    }
    // Lower charts: a short running mean of each yearly-average line, to take out day-to-day jitter.
    function smooth(a, w) {
      var out = new Float32Array(n), sum = 0, cnt = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (!isNaN(a[i])) { sum += a[i]; cnt++; }
        if (i >= w && !isNaN(a[i - w])) { sum -= a[i - w]; cnt--; }
        out[i] = cnt > 0 && !isNaN(a[i]) ? sum / cnt : NaN;
      }
      return out;
    }
    var avgHi = trailing(hi), avgLo = trailing(lo), diff = new Float32Array(n);
    for (var q = 0; q < n; q++) diff[q] = avgHi[q] - avgLo[q];
    var tHi = smooth(avgHi, TREND_SMOOTH_DAYS), tLo = smooth(avgLo, TREND_SMOOTH_DAYS), tDiff = smooth(diff, TREND_SMOOTH_DAYS);
    var rHi = range(tHi), rLo = range(tLo), rDiff = range(tDiff);
    // Running sums for a straight-line (least-squares) fit of each lower line up to any day,
    // so the trend line can be updated every frame without re-reading the data.
    function fitSums(a) {
      var c = new Float64Array(n), sx = new Float64Array(n), sxx = new Float64Array(n),
          sy = new Float64Array(n), sxy = new Float64Array(n), first = -1;
      var C = 0, SX = 0, SXX = 0, SY = 0, SXY = 0;
      for (var i = i0; i < n; i++) {
        if (!isNaN(a[i])) {
          var d = i - i0;
          if (first < 0) first = i;
          C++; SX += d; SXX += d * d; SY += a[i]; SXY += d * a[i];
        }
        c[i] = C; sx[i] = SX; sxx[i] = SXX; sy[i] = SY; sxy[i] = SXY;
      }
      return { c: c, sx: sx, sxx: sxx, sy: sy, sxy: sxy, first: first };
    }
    // both trend bands use the same degrees-per-pixel so their slopes are comparable
    var tSpan = Math.max(rHi.span, rLo.span, rDiff.span, 0.5) * 1.25;

    return { fHi: fitSums(tHi), fLo: fitSums(tLo), fDiff: fitSums(tDiff), i0: i0, rHi: rHi, rLo: rLo, rDiff: rDiff, tHi: tHi, tLo: tLo, tDiff: tDiff, tSpan: tSpan, n: n, time: time, hi: hi, lo: lo, x: x, year: year, yStart: yStart, yEnd: yEnd,
             avgHi: avgHi, avgLo: avgLo, min: min, max: max,
             firstYear: year[i0], lastYear: year[n - 1] };
  }

  function load(lat, lon, name) {
    place = { lat: lat, lon: lon, name: name || (lat.toFixed(2) + '°, ' + lon.toFixed(2) + '°') };
    var startYear = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(startEl.value, 10) || 1980, 1940), thisYear - 1);
    startEl.value = startYear; loadedStart = startYear;
    var key = lat.toFixed(2) + ',' + lon.toFixed(2) + ',' + startYear;
    var id = ++reqId;
    if (playing) setPlaying(false);                // hold the current animation while the new place loads
    if (marker && map) marker.setLatLng([lat, lon]);
    setStatus('Loading temperatures for ' + place.name + '…', 'loading', 'This can take a few seconds.');

    // Cancel a request that is still in flight, so quick clicks don't pile up on the weather service.
    if (inflight) { inflight.abort(); inflight = null; }
    var ctrl = window.AbortController ? new AbortController() : null;
    var url = 'https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=' + lat.toFixed(4) +
      '&longitude=' + lon.toFixed(4) + '&start_date=' + Math.max(1940, startYear - 1) + '-01-01&end_date=' + isoDaysAgo(6) +
      '&daily=temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min&timezone=auto';

    // The free service sometimes answers "too many requests"; wait and try again a few times.
    function attempt(tries) {
      return fetch(url, ctrl ? { signal: ctrl.signal } : undefined).then(function (r) {
        return r.json().then(function (j) { return { status: r.status, j: j }; });
      }).then(function (res) {
        var j = res.j, busy = res.status === 429 || (j.error && /concurrent|limit|too many/i.test(j.reason || ''));
        if (busy && tries < RETRY_WAITS.length) {
          var wait = RETRY_WAITS[tries];
          if (id === reqId) setStatus('The weather service is busy. Trying again in ' + wait + ' seconds…', 'loading', 'Loading temperatures for ' + place.name + '.');
          return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            var timer = setTimeout(resolve, wait * 1000);
            if (ctrl) ctrl.signal.addEventListener('abort', function () { clearTimeout(timer); reject(new Error('cancelled')); });
          }).then(function () { return attempt(tries + 1); });
        }
        if (busy) throw new Error('The weather service is busy right now. Wait a minute, then click the map again.');
        if (j.error) throw new Error(j.reason || 'The weather service returned an error.');
        return build(j.daily, startYear);
      });
    }

    var p = cache[key];
    if (!p) { p = cache[key] = attempt(0); inflight = ctrl; }

    p.then(function (data) {
      if (id !== reqId) return;                      // a newer click won
      inflight = null;
      S = data; pos = S.i0;
      scrub.min = S.firstYear; scrub.max = S.lastYear;
      setStatus(place.name + ' · ' + S.firstYear + '–' + S.lastYear, 'done');
      if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
        pos = S.n - 1; setPlaying(false);
      } else setPlaying(true);
      draw();
    }).catch(function (e) {
      delete cache[key];
      if (id !== reqId) return;
      loadedStart = null;
      inflight = null;
      setStatus('Could not load data', 'error', String(e && e.message ? e.message : e));
    });
  }

  // ---- Drawing ---------------------------------------------------------
  function conv(c) { return unit === 'F' ? c * 1.8 + 32 : c; }

  function niceStep(range, target) {
    var raw = range / target, mag = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(raw))), f = raw / mag;
    return (f < 1.5 ? 1 : f < 3.5 ? 2 : f < 7.5 ? 5 : 10) * mag;
  }

  function fit(canvas, ctx) {
    var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    var w = Math.max(1, Math.round(r.width * dpr)), h = Math.max(1, Math.round(r.height * dpr));
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) { canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h; }
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    return { w: r.width, h: r.height };
  }

  var MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
  var MONTH_START = [0, 31, 59, 90, 120, 151, 181, 212, 243, 273, 304, 334];

  function draw() {
    var size = fit(canvas, ctx), W = size.w, H = size.h;
    var cs = getComputedStyle(root), ink = cs.color, font = cs.fontFamily;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    var L = 46, R = W < 520 ? 46 : 92, T = 14, B = 28;
    var pw = W - L - R, ph = H - T - B;
    drawTrend(ink, font);
    if (pw < 50 || ph < 50) return;

    ctx.font = '12px ' + font;
    ctx.fillStyle = ink; ctx.strokeStyle = ink; ctx.lineWidth = 1;

    if (!S) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = .25; ctx.strokeRect(L + .5, T + .5, pw, ph); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      return;
    }

    var lo = conv(S.min), hi = conv(S.max), pad = (hi - lo) * .06;
    lo -= pad; hi += pad;
    var X = function (f) { return L + f * pw; };
    var Y = function (c) { return T + (hi - conv(c)) / (hi - lo) * ph; };

    // grid + axes
    var step = niceStep(hi - lo, Math.max(3, Math.floor(ph / 55)));
    ctx.textAlign = 'right'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    for (var v = Math.ceil(lo / step) * step; v <= hi; v += step) {
      var gy = T + (hi - v) / (hi - lo) * ph;
      ctx.globalAlpha = .13; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(L, gy); ctx.lineTo(L + pw, gy); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalAlpha = .75; ctx.fillText(Math.round(v) + '°' + unit, L - 6, gy);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    var everyOther = pw < 420;
    for (var m = 0; m < 12; m++) {
      var mx = X(MONTH_START[m] / 365);
      ctx.globalAlpha = .1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(mx, T); ctx.lineTo(mx, T + ph); ctx.stroke();
      if (!everyOther || m % 2 === 0) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = .75; ctx.fillText(MONTHS[m], X((MONTH_START[m] + 15) / 365), T + ph + 7);
      }
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = .35; ctx.strokeRect(L + .5, T + .5, pw, ph); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    var i = Math.min(S.n - 1, Math.floor(pos)), curYear = S.year[i];

    // big year in the background
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = .1; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.font = '700 ' + Math.min(140, pw / 3.2) + 'px ' + font;
    ctx.fillText(curYear, L + pw / 2, T + ph / 2);
    ctx.restore();

    // yearly traces: oldest first so the newest sits on top
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(L, T, pw, ph); ctx.clip();
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round'; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    for (var y = Math.max(S.firstYear, curYear - FADE_YEARS - 1); y <= curYear; y++) {
      if (!(y in S.yStart)) continue;
      var a = Math.max(S.i0, S.yStart[y]), b = Math.min(S.yEnd[y], i), alpha = 1;
      if (y < curYear) {
        var age = (pos - S.yEnd[y]) / 365.25;           // years since that year finished
        alpha = Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - age / FADE_YEARS), 1.6) * .8;
      }
      if (alpha <= .004) continue;
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      ctx.lineWidth = y === curYear ? 1.8 : 1.1;
      trace(S.hi, a, b, HIGH_COLOR, X, Y);
      trace(S.lo, a, b, LOW_COLOR, X, Y);
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // moving yearly-average lines
    var frac = pos - i, j = Math.min(S.n - 1, i + 1);
    avgLine(lerp(S.avgHi[i], S.avgHi[j], frac), HIGH_COLOR, 'avg high', L, pw, R, Y, font);
    avgLine(lerp(S.avgLo[i], S.avgLo[j], frac), LOW_COLOR, 'avg low', L, pw, R, Y, font);

    // legend
    ctx.font = '12px ' + font; ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    var lx = L + 10, ly = T + 14;
    [['Daily high', HIGH_COLOR], ['Daily low', LOW_COLOR]].forEach(function (e) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = e[1]; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(lx, ly); ctx.lineTo(lx + 18, ly); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = ink; ctx.fillText(e[0], lx + 24, ly);
      lx += 34 + ctx.measureText(e[0]).width;
    });

    // controls readout
    yearEl.textContent = curYear;
    if (document.activeElement !== scrub) scrub.value = curYear;
  }

  // ---- Trend chart: the two averages over the whole period ---------------
  function drawTrend(ink, font) {
    var c = tctx, size = fit(trend, c), W = size.w, H = size.h;
    c.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    var L = 46, R = W < 520 ? 46 : 92, T = 8, B = 26, GAP = 12;
    var pw = W - L - R, bh = (H - T - B - GAP * 2) / 3;
    if (pw < 50 || bh < 30) return;
    c.font = '12px ' + font; c.lineWidth = 1;
    var bands = [
      { top: T, r: S && S.rHi, arr: S && S.tHi, fit: S && S.fHi, color: HIGH_COLOR, label: 'Average daily high' },
      { top: T + bh + GAP, r: S && S.rLo, arr: S && S.tLo, fit: S && S.fLo, color: LOW_COLOR, label: 'Average daily low' },
      { top: T + (bh + GAP) * 2, r: S && S.rDiff, arr: S && S.tDiff, fit: S && S.fDiff, color: DIFF_COLOR, label: 'Average high minus average low' }
    ];
    if (!S) {
      c.strokeStyle = ink; c.globalAlpha = .25;
      bands.forEach(function (b) { c.strokeRect(L + .5, b.top + .5, pw, bh); });
      c.globalAlpha = 1; return;
    }
    var i = Math.min(S.n - 1, Math.floor(pos));
    var X = function (k) { return L + (k - S.i0) / (S.n - 1 - S.i0) * pw; };

    // year ticks, shared by both bands
    var years = S.lastYear - S.firstYear + 1, stepY = 1;
    [1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50].some(function (s) { stepY = s; return years / s <= pw / 55; });
    c.fillStyle = ink; c.strokeStyle = ink;
    for (var y = Math.ceil(S.firstYear / stepY) * stepY; y <= S.lastYear; y += stepY) {
      if (!(y in S.yStart)) continue;
      var tx = X(S.yStart[y]);
      c.globalAlpha = .1; c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(tx, T); c.lineTo(tx, H - B); c.stroke();
      c.globalAlpha = .75; c.textAlign = 'center'; c.textBaseline = 'top';
      if (tx > L + 12 && tx < L + pw - 12) c.fillText(y, tx, H - B + 7);
    }

    var stride = Math.max(1, Math.floor((S.n - S.i0) / (pw * 3)));
    bands.forEach(function (b) {
      var loC = b.r.mid - S.tSpan / 2, hiC = b.r.mid + S.tSpan / 2;
      // the difference band is a size in degrees, not a temperature, so it converts without the 32° offset
      var cv = b.color === DIFF_COLOR ? function (v) { return unit === 'F' ? v * 1.8 : v; } : conv;
      var lo = cv(loC), hi = cv(hiC);
      var Y = function (v) { return b.top + (hiC - v) / (hiC - loC) * bh; };
      // grid
      var step = niceStep(hi - lo, 3);
      c.fillStyle = ink; c.strokeStyle = ink; c.lineWidth = 1;
      c.textAlign = 'right'; c.textBaseline = 'middle';
      for (var v = Math.ceil(lo / step) * step; v <= hi; v += step) {
        var gy = b.top + (hi - v) / (hi - lo) * bh;
        if (gy < b.top + 4 || gy > b.top + bh - 4) continue;
        c.globalAlpha = .13; c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(L, gy); c.lineTo(L + pw, gy); c.stroke();
        c.globalAlpha = .75; c.fillText((step < 1 ? v.toFixed(1) : Math.round(v)) + '°' + unit, L - 6, gy);
      }
      c.globalAlpha = .35; c.strokeRect(L + .5, b.top + .5, pw, bh);
      c.globalAlpha = .75; c.textAlign = 'left'; c.textBaseline = 'top';
      // straight-line trend through everything drawn so far (shown once there are two years to fit)
      var f = b.fit, cnt = f.c[i], label = b.label;
      if (cnt >= TREND_MIN_DAYS) {
        var den = cnt * f.sxx[i] - f.sx[i] * f.sx[i];
        var slope = (cnt * f.sxy[i] - f.sx[i] * f.sy[i]) / den;          // °C per day
        var icpt = (f.sy[i] - slope * f.sx[i]) / cnt;
        var perDecade = slope * 3652.5 * (unit === 'F' ? 1.8 : 1);
        var shown = Math.abs(perDecade) < 0.005 ? '0.00' : (perDecade > 0 ? '+' : '−') + Math.abs(perDecade).toFixed(2);
        label += '  ·  trend ' + shown + '°' + unit + ' per decade';
        c.save();
        c.beginPath(); c.rect(L, b.top, pw, bh); c.clip();
        c.globalAlpha = .8; c.strokeStyle = ink; c.lineWidth = 1.5; c.setLineDash([6, 4]);
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(X(f.first), Y(icpt + slope * (f.first - S.i0)));
        c.lineTo(X(i), Y(icpt + slope * (i - S.i0)));
        c.stroke();
        c.restore();
      }
      c.fillText(label, L + 8, b.top + 6);
      // the line so far
      c.globalAlpha = 1; c.strokeStyle = b.color; c.lineWidth = 2; c.lineJoin = 'round';
      c.beginPath();
      var pen = false, lastK = -1;
      for (var k = S.i0; k <= i; k += stride) {
        if (isNaN(b.arr[k])) continue;
        if (pen) c.lineTo(X(k), Y(b.arr[k])); else { c.moveTo(X(k), Y(b.arr[k])); pen = true; }
        lastK = k;
      }
      if (!isNaN(b.arr[i])) { if (pen) c.lineTo(X(i), Y(b.arr[i])); lastK = i; }
      c.stroke();
      // the moving head and its value
      if (lastK >= 0) {
        var hx = X(lastK), hy = Y(b.arr[lastK]);
        c.fillStyle = b.color; c.beginPath(); c.arc(hx, hy, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); c.fill();
        c.font = '600 12px ' + font; c.textBaseline = 'middle'; c.textAlign = 'left';
        c.fillText(cv(b.arr[lastK]).toFixed(1) + '°', L + pw + 5, Math.max(b.top + 8, Math.min(b.top + bh - 8, hy)));
        c.font = '12px ' + font;
      }
    });
    c.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function lerp(a, b, t) { return isNaN(b) ? a : a + (b - a) * t; }

  function trace(arr, a, b, color, X, Y) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.beginPath();
    var pen = false;
    for (var k = a; k <= b; k++) {
      if (arr[k] == null) { pen = false; continue; }
      var px = X(S.x[k]), py = Y(arr[k]);
      if (pen) ctx.lineTo(px, py); else { ctx.moveTo(px, py); pen = true; }
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function avgLine(c, color, label, L, pw, R, Y, font) {
    if (isNaN(c)) return;
    var y = Y(c);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.globalAlpha = .95;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(L, y); ctx.lineTo(L + pw, y); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.font = '600 12px ' + font; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    var text = conv(c).toFixed(1) + '°';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(R > 60 ? text + ' ' + label : text, L + pw + 5, y);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---- Animation loop --------------------------------------------------
  function setPlaying(on) {
    playing = on; lastT = 0;
    playBtn.textContent = on ? 'Pause' : (S && pos >= S.n - 1 ? 'Replay' : 'Play');
    if (on) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  function tick(t) {
    if (!playing || !S) return;
    var dt = lastT ? Math.min(.1, (t - lastT) / 1000) : 0;
    lastT = t;
    pos += dt * 365.25 / SPEEDS[+speedEl.value];
    if (pos >= S.n - 1) { pos = S.n - 1; draw(); setPlaying(false); return; }
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  // ---- Controls --------------------------------------------------------
  function showSpeed() {
    var s = SPEEDS[+speedEl.value];
    speedLabel.textContent = s >= 1 ? s + ' s/yr' : (1 / s) + ' yr/s';
  }
  speedEl.addEventListener('input', showSpeed); showSpeed();

  playBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!S) return;
    if (!playing && pos >= S.n - 1) pos = S.i0;
    setPlaying(!playing);
  });
  $('ta-restart').addEventListener('click', function () { if (S) { pos = S.i0; setPlaying(true); } });
  scrub.addEventListener('input', function () {
    if (!S) return;
    var y = +scrub.value;
    if (y in S.yStart) { pos = S.yStart[y]; draw(); if (!playing) setPlaying(false); }
  });
  unitBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    unit = unit === 'F' ? 'C' : 'F'; unitBtn.textContent = '°' + unit; draw();
  });
  trend.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!S) return;
    var r = trend.getBoundingClientRect(), L = 46, R = r.width < 520 ? 46 : 92;
    var f = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (e.clientX - r.left - L) / (r.width - L - R)));
    pos = S.i0 + f * (S.n - 1 - S.i0); draw(); if (!playing) setPlaying(false);
  });
  // Start year: reload shortly after the value settles, whether typed or stepped with the arrows.
  // The short wait means several arrow clicks make one request instead of one per click.
  var startTimer = null, loadedStart = null;
  function startChanged(delay) {
    clearTimeout(startTimer);
    startTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      var y = parseInt(startEl.value, 10);
      if (!place || isNaN(y) || y < 1940 || y > thisYear - 1 || y === loadedStart) return;
      load(place.lat, place.lon, place.name);
    }, delay);
  }
  startEl.addEventListener('input', function () { startChanged(700); });
  startEl.addEventListener('change', function () { startChanged(700); });
  startEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); startChanged(0); } });

  $('ta-q').addEventListener('input', function () { if (playing) setPlaying(false); });   // typing a search pauses
  $('ta-search').addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var q = $('ta-q').value.trim();
    if (!q) return;
    setStatus('Searching for “' + q + '”…', 'loading');
    fetch('https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search?count=1&name=' + encodeURIComponent(q))
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (j) {
        var hit = j.results && j.results[0];
        if (!hit) { setStatus('No place found for “' + q + '”.', 'note'); return; }
        var name = [hit.name, hit.admin1, hit.country].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
        if (map) map.setView([hit.latitude, hit.longitude], 7);
        load(hit.latitude, hit.longitude, name);
      })
      .catch(function () { setStatus('Search is unavailable right now.', 'note'); });
  });

  // ---- Map -------------------------------------------------------------
  if (window.L) {
    map = L.map('ta-map', { worldCopyJump: true }).setView([DEFAULT_PLACE.lat, DEFAULT_PLACE.lon], 4);
    L.tileLayer('https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
      maxZoom: 12, attribution: '© OpenStreetMap contributors'
    }).addTo(map);
    marker = L.circleMarker([DEFAULT_PLACE.lat, DEFAULT_PLACE.lon],
      { radius: 8, color: '#111', weight: 2, fillColor: HIGH_COLOR, fillOpacity: .9 }).addTo(map);
    map.on('click', function (e) {
      var p = e.latlng.wrap();
      load(p.lat, p.lng);
    });
  } else {
    $('ta-map').textContent = 'The map could not load. Use the search box to pick a place.';
  }

  if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(function () { draw(); }).observe(canvas);
  else window.addEventListener('resize', draw);

  load(DEFAULT_PLACE.lat, DEFAULT_PLACE.lon, DEFAULT_PLACE.name);
})();
</script>
```
